posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Ugh, allergies, yes. They’ve been worse in other years, but this year they’re just constant. DX

It’s a little rude of Christopher to remind us we’re all slowly dying, since he can never die. Check your immortal privilege, yo. >:|

Time to bring out the Citizen Hammer pony again. Or was it actually an Adam pony? I do not want to figure this out!

It starts with Felicia Parsons, you say? And Adam said we wouldn’t figure out who was on the cover!

The Oracle having, like, emotions, is such a weird idea somehow!

Oh man, Exile? Wild!

Oh, maybe it’s actually X-ile. Or X-Aisle? Maybe it’s “X-I’ll”, as in, “You say shit about my X, I’ll crush your head!”

I’m happy to be getting another look at Legacy of Destruction. I really appreciate how different he is from Iron Legacy. I-Legs is very brooding, calculating, exacting vengeance molecule by molecule as he beats people to a pulp. LoD is a Saturday morning cartoon villain. He’s just here to have a good time, and having a good time means being a jerk and breaking shit. I’ll bet he enjoys having nightmares. He probably likes his steak crispy.

Which now makes me think, “Legacy of Destruction’s Magical Bar-Be-Que”. <_< And now I want the metaverse to have had a cartoon for a D-list hero, airing around the same time as the old live-action Wraith show, whose animation is repurposed in the aughts to make a parody talk show.

Magic guy’s gonna be, who, the Seer?

ZHU LONG? I’ve never considered a heroic Zhu Long before, oh man, that’s awesome, this is shaping up to be a fantastic issue. (There’s also something to be said for them telling us a story they already know as opposed to making it up in real-time.)

Ah yes, letting Exile loose in your sacred orrery, one of the classic blunders.

Oh, tell me the Oracle’s mad because they discovered the fourth wall.

LMFAO, what a fucking story XD Could not have asked for a better sendoff/transition period for Disparation. Why does this feel like it’s Guise’s fault somehow?

I like this cursed pen future.

She bends words the way he bends Pauls!

Soothsayer Carmichael being an Oracle of Discord fanboy. XD

Ooh, Hannah Hall confirmed for DE Visionary deck!

I thought the answer to this Vanessa Long Fixed Point question was that it’s not “in every universe, Vanessa Long will get powers”, but “in every universe which has Vanessa Long, she gets powers”.

And if Christopher’s spine breaks a third time, we’ll know it’s enemy action!

Ur-space is made up of the stuff that universes could be made from.

At this point, C&A know exactly what expectations they’ve created by revealing that nemesis symbol, and I cannot imagine the bad blood they’d create with their fans if they went “You know that deck you’ve all wanted for years? Well, surprise, we created the first ever variant with their own nemesis symbol! Oops! Silly us!”

There are a couple different ways you can lie to your fans, lying to protect secrets/future content, or a malicious lie, and them playing with fan expectations like that would certainly feel malicious to me.
